findings.title: Finnhub delivery does not establish original-publisher identity or credibility
findings.observation: 108 retained AAPL events use finnhub.io URLs; provider source_name claims Yahoo86/CNBC8/Benzinga12/SeekingAlpha2. Both retained archives contain the same distribution and are not independent 216-event corroboration.
findings.disposition: Allow intermediary/advisory ingestion only; reject blanket publisher-authority approval.
findings.required_before_release: Establish original publisher URL/identity/content provenance, permitted use and representative target coverage; do not convert source_name into a verified-authority flag.

findings.title: No verified HistData venue/historical holiday binding
findings.observation: Current OANDA BVI CFD regular hours are not evidence of HistData venue identity or effective 2025 holidays. The reference comparison has 14133 absent minutes while reference-open and 9459 observations while reference-closed. These differences cannot be equated with genuine loss or genuine closure.
findings.disposition: Approve comparison-only diagnostic; reject certified session-completeness/closure claims.
findings.required_before_release: Obtain source-bound historical regular/holiday/exception evidence or an appropriately assessed replacement source; reconcile every unresolved interval without guessing time corrections.

findings.title: Perfect small-sample scores do not validate deployed policy/calibration
findings.observation: FinancialPhraseBank supplies independent original sentiment labels but all event/policy options are allowed and there are no attack cases. The primary/adversarial pilot labels are author-supplied. Self-reported confidence0.7 and fixed event windows have no demonstrated production calibration/performance basis.
findings.disposition: Approve observed benchmark agreement and deterministic restriction implementation only.
findings.required_before_release: Define representative US/ETF/gold/source-conflict/correction policy cases and independent expected decisions, assess calibration/error severity, and validate policy suitability on point-in-time histories before deployment.

findings.title: Exact quoted evidence is structural grounding, not semantic fact verification
findings.observation: Membership of an exact headline/summary quote does not prove that sentiment, severity or market-impact assertions follow from that quote. This is a known limit of schema/evidence checks.
findings.disposition: Retain advisory-only scope and manual/source review; do not label all model assertions verified facts.
findings.required_before_release: Add semantic evidence review to representative quality assessment; never use exact-quote success alone as a source-authority approval.

findings.title: Session reference rule is manually bound rather than extracted from evidence
findings.observation: The comparator verifies an HTML hash/status but originally hardcodes18:05–16:59 without machine-checking that the supplied snapshot supports those exact rule values. Current archived text supports them; a changed future snapshot could be paired with unchanged constants.
findings.disposition: Current comparison evidence acceptable with manual source confirmation; improve reproducible rule-to-snapshot binding.
findings.required_before_release: Record extracted rule/excerpt and assert it matches the snapshot; unsupported snapshots should not inherit old reference hours.
findings.resolution: Implementation author added verify_reference_rule, strict unique exact XAU/USD table extraction, fixed-URL bounded acquisition and comparison rule verification. Reviewer independently confirmed actual snapshot row is accepted and an18:06 mutation rejected.

findings.title: Current-facing provider table contains obsolete implementation claims
findings.observation: At review start, the provider table still called the FOMC adapter unimplemented and gold provider selection unresolved despite existing adapters/conditional source.
findings.disposition: Update current-facing table while retaining historical reports unchanged.
findings.required_before_release: Align overview with actual implemented/conditional capabilities and explicit remaining evidence gates.
findings.resolution: Reviewer independently confirmed current provider table now states implemented official FOMC, conditional HistData reference history and Alpaca actions.

limitations: Separate AI technical review is not an independent human/domain/legal/Shariah or institutional audit
Prior outputs were visible; this review did not create a new blind holdout
Network traffic, historical truth, licensing approval and vendor historical schedules were not independently authenticated
No live trading or profitability validation; remaining release blockers must not be removed by a passing diagnostic
